text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, music) ::: George likes music.
WantsToCompose(x) ::: George wants to compose.
HasAccessToProgram(x) ::: George has access to a program.
CanCompose(x) ::: George can compose.
Compose(x) ::: George will compose.
Premises:
Likes(george, music) → WantsToCompose(george) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
HasAccessToProgram(george) → CanCompose(george) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
CanCompose(george) ∧ WantsToCompose(george) → Compose(george) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
¬Compose(george) → ¬CanCompose(george) ::: If George will not compose, George cannot compose.
